title: Databridge
description: A platform for secure, two-way data exchange between services across cloud environments. It handled an average of 1,000+ transactions per second and peaks of 5,000+.
details: Configurable pipelines supported different data exchange requirements.
Real-time alerts and KPI tracking supported around-the-clock monitoring.

title: Integration Activity Service
description: A backend service that gave teams a consistent REST API for data integration.
details: DynamoDB supported high request volumes and growing data capacity.

title: Banking 3.0
description: A redesign of banking data flows that moved processing from a set of microservices to a pipeline architecture.
details: The redesign split existing workflows into distinct pipelines and processing stages.
Reusable processors supported different banking workflows.

title: Mobile Media Processor
description: A backend service that processed mobile media data for multiple customers and produced business intelligence reports.
details: The service stored processed data in Amazon RDS for reporting.
Reports could be tailored to individual customers’ needs.
